policy_history.summary: Use a bounded stock-coverage operating response, but defer policy and parameter changes: inventory is 58 units versus 153 median online-peer stock, with 27 stockouts and 9 own paid sales in 60 minutes. Supply execution still requires fresh guards, and the shop is reported nondiscoverable. Goods conversion remains weak, with 1/23 closed orders paid and all 40 goods quotes above cap; do not relax price caps. The challenger is not promotion-ready, and the rating holdout is predictive rather than causal with rank mapping unverified.

Allow bounded stock-coverage and buyer price-gap routing responses: recent stockouts are high, while goods quotes repeatedly exceed the price cap. Keep research parameters and operating policy unchanged; do not promote the challenger because mature canonical results are absent and the evaluation is not ready. Transport issues and declining external-trade rate argue against broader inventory changes.

Market activity is substantial but easing (786 trades in 20 minutes; rate ratio 0.906). Own stock is low versus peers (50 vs median 191) with 39 stockouts, supporting bounded coverage routing. Food conversion exceeds goods (50/88 vs 3/32 closed orders), while goods quotes are frequently above cap (53/54). Keep the operating policy unchanged; do not promote the challenger, infer demand from observational preferences, or change price caps. The holdout is predictive but noncausal, and official stars-rank mapping is unverified.

Stockouts (39 in 60 minutes) and inventory below the online-peer median support bounded stock-coverage and eligible failed-contract routing responses, subject to live supply checks. Retain the diversified shop plan and current operating policy: market trade rate is near flat, while transport and discoverability blockers remain. Goods conversion is weak and most goods quotes exceed the cap; recovery probes must not relax price caps. Challenger promotion is unsupported: evaluation is not ready and canonical mature buyer outcomes are absent.

Keep the current research parameters and operating policy. Stockouts are elevated (44 in 60 minutes) against 51 units of stock, while shop sales and external trade activity remain substantial. However, defensive controls and unhealthy transport block restocking, so do not issue a stock-coverage operating intent until live guards permit it. Goods contracts convert poorly and are mostly above cap; retain the existing buyer settings and do not change the price cap. The challenger is not ready for promotion. Although the diversified plan has the strongest modeled supply-plan utility, execution remains guarded and its projection is not realized performance.

Authorize bounded measurement-based stock coverage and buyer price-failure routing, but do not approve economic promotion or change trial parameters. Stock is low (51 units versus 237 median peer stock) with 41 stockouts in 60 minutes; the supply plan favors diversified stocking, though defensive/discoverability blocks remain. Buyer goods conversion is weak (4/36 closed orders paid in the recent 60 minutes), and 59/60 goods quotes were above cap. Keep the current operating policy and avoid treating routing as a price-cap exception. The challenger is not promotion-ready; the quality holdout is predictive, not causal, and official rank mapping remains unverified.

Approve bounded operating responses: stockouts are elevated despite near-flat-to-slightly-rising market activity, and buyer recovery routing is justified by repeated above-cap failures. Keep operating policy and buyer parameters at baseline; the diversified supply plan has the highest supplied utility, but discovery and defensive/stale-control blocks require live checks. Do not promote the challenger: evaluation is not ready, and its apparent uplift lacks sufficient mature evidence.

Approve bounded stock-coverage and buyer price-gap routing responses, while retaining the current operating policy and profile parameters. Stockouts (49 in 60 minutes) and 48 units of stock versus 198 median peer stock support a coverage response, though external trade rate is essentially flat and a discoverability block is recorded. Goods conversion is weak (5/43 closed orders paid) and 61/62 goods quotes were above cap; route qualifying repeated failures to recovery probes without changing the cap. Do not promote a challenger: evaluation is not ready and has only 9 paid challenger outcomes. The quality holdout is predictive, not causal, and official stars-rank mapping is unverified.

limitations: Scenarios are unexecuted model forecasts, not proof of extra sales or causal gains.
Public board and local inventory have separately recorded observation times.
Raw stockout events include repeated negotiation turns; distinct tasks are also reported.
Inventory residual includes timing, expiry/disposal and other changes; no waste attribution without evidence.
Baseline board precedes runtime start; local before/after periods use the exact runtime start.
Gross margins precede future refunds and storage.
